description: Weighted strength + skill acquisition. Heavy work gets CNS priority, skills separate.
coreRule: Heavy weighted work ALWAYS gets CNS priority. Skills bolted on END of weighted sessions or given their own day.

3-4_days.name: Bolt-On
3-4_days.description: Street Lifter sessions intact. 2-3 skill exercises at END.

4-5_days.name: PPL + Skill Day
4-5_days.description: Pure push/pull/leg days + dedicated skill day(s).

5_days_competition.name: KOW Hybrid
5_days_competition.description: Street Lifter Advanced is the entire program. Skills as assistance only.

phases.name: base_building
phases.guidance: Building the base for both domains. Moderate weighted intensity.

phases.name: intensification
phases.guidance: Pushing intensity. Heavier loads, harder skill progressions.

phases.name: specialization
phases.guidance: Arnold asks: weighted PRs or skill PRs? Chosen domain gets full focus, other drops to maintenance.

phases.name: test
phases.guidance: PR attempts on BOTH weighted lifts AND skill holds.

synergyAdaptationRules.scenario: Front lever stalled, weighted pull-ups progressing
synergyAdaptationRules.response: Increase front lever frequency +1/week. Add FL rows as accessory. Strength is there — skill needs more practice.

synergyAdaptationRules.scenario: Front lever stalled, pull-ups ALSO stalled
synergyAdaptationRules.response: Focus weighted pull-ups 2-3 weeks, drop FL to maintenance. Raw strength is the bottleneck.
Increase planche frequency. Add pseudo planche push-ups. Pressing strength is there — straight-arm skill needs work.
Focus weighted dips 2-3 weeks, drop planche to maintenance. Rebuild pressing base.

synergyAdaptationRules.scenario: Weighted lifts regressing after adding skills
synergyAdaptationRules.response: Skill volume stealing recovery. Reduce skill sessions by 1/week or cut bolt-on from 3 to 1 exercise.
Trigger deload. After deload, focus weighted 2-3 weeks, then reintroduce skills gradually.

boltOnSkillBlock.rules: Select 2-3 exercises. Total time 10-15 min. Never to failure.
